text:
alex: Morning — quick release scrub. Cut window opens in ~2.5h. Canary health looks OK, one cherry pending (quant-swap). Keeping other cherrypicks on hold unless urgent :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Which PR is the quant-swap? owner?

alex: PR #4582, assigned to devon. Failing unit test on serializer, looks flaky. I flagged it as a potential blocker if it doesn't stabilize before cut.

devon: saw it. Reproduced locally, failing in `test_serialize_roundtrip` on long sequences. Investigating now, will push a fix + rerun in ~25–30m.

devon: quick log snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 0x4f but got 0x00
  at serializers/quantize_test.py:78
```

sarah: @devon I can spin up a debug instance with the same GPU image if you want deeper tracing. Ping me when you have a repro.

devon: thanks — will ping in ~10 when I have a deterministic repro.

release-bot: Canary group stable. p50=48ms p95=120ms errors=0.02% (last 10m). No new rollbacks.

maya: Is there any CI infra flakiness right now? saw some kube jobs requeueing earlier.

alex: eng-infra reported a transient node eviction in us-west-2 ~45m ago, but it auto-healed. Not impacting canaries now. If tests hit noisy nodes, that could explain flakes.

devon: re: CI — my failing job ran on `runner-gpu-7`. CI logs show kernel OOM in python process before test assertion. Filing a follow-up if fix doesn't work.

alex: Plan for today: 1) wait for devon fix + green CI on #4582, 2) if green, merge & cherry into release-branch, 3) freeze non-urgent cherries, 4) smoke canaries after merge and report back here.

maya: SGTM. If #4582 doesn't green by cut, do we have a fallback?

alex: fallback is to postpone that cherry and re-run the scheduled patch after the cut. We should only push it if tests are green + perf looks fine on canaries.

devon: pushed a fix (force-push) and retriggered CI. Noted the flaky kube runner. If CI green, I'll request merge and assign someone for final review.

alex: ping @maya for review when CI passes — quick look only, focus on serializer edge case.

maya: Will do asap. If I can't get to it in 20m, @sarah can you spare a quick eyeball?

sarah: Yep, can take it if needed.

alex: Thanks all — keep updates here. If anyone sees new spikes on canary, post graphs (p95/p99 + errors). :thumbsup:

devon: CI passed! requesting merge, and I'll create the cherry PR targeting `release/v2.6` after merge.

maya: Reviewing now.

alex: Nice — once cherry is in, let's run a short canary job (10k tokens) and watch latency + errors for 30m.

release-bot: Canary job scheduled: job-id `canary-277801` starts in 5m.

maya: Quick note — hold other cherry PRs that touch kv-cache until we verify this one. Avoid cascade.

alex: Agreed. Final: keep this thread for status updates only. Thanks!
